### Edgewise Therapeutics to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences


November 9, 2026


BOULDER, Colo.


, Nov. 9, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Edgewise Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: EWTX), a leading clinical-stage cardiovascular biopharmaceutical company, today announced that management will participate in the following investor conferences:


**Guggenheim 3rd Annual Healthcare Innovation Conference** **Fireside chat:** Tuesday, November 10, 2026 at 8:00 am ET


**2026 Truist Biopharma Symposium** **Fireside chat:** Thursday, November 12, 2026 at 10:30 am ET


The webcasts can be found on the Edgewise[Events & Presentations page](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4816753-1&h=975227749&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.edgewisetx.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&a=Events+%26+Presentations+page) and will be accessible for replay, for a limited time, following the conference. It is recommended that users connect to the live webcast several minutes prior to the start to ensure a timely connection.


**About Edgewise Therapeutics**


Edgewise Therapeutics is a cardiovascular biopharmaceutical company developing novel therapies intended to address cardiac equilibrium, the balance of contraction and relaxation across the cardiac cycle. Drawing on deep expertise in integrated muscle physiology and small molecule drug development, Edgewise is advancing novel therapies intended to fine-tune cardiac muscle function and improve treatment options for people with symptomatic hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and heart failure. To learn more, go to[edgewisetx.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4816753-1&h=2683250997&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedgewisetx.com%2F&a=edgewisetx.com%C2%A0) or follow Edgewise on[LinkedIn](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4816753-1&h=3798257359&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fedgewisetx&a=LinkedIn) and[X](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4816753-1&h=276431069&u=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2FEdgewiseTx&a=X) .
